answer.rationale: Avoid promotional pricing: the directly recovered targeted-discount result produced short-term qualified-revenue lift but a 12% 30-day retention decline, making a price-war response inconsistent with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Simplified onboarding is confirmed to improve completion, reduce time-to-value, and raise 30-day retention, offering the strongest available durable SMB lever without extending discounting beyond its harmful cohort evidence. Its ability to offset immediate price-driven churn remains uncertain, so deploy as a standard experiment rather than a broad rollout.
